chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Abān, from Zurārah, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “Water is not to be heated for the deceased.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: A title referring to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام in this narration
key_terms.الْمَاءُ: The water used here for washing the deceased
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon him; honorific used for the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to heat water for washing the deceased in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the preparation of the deceased for ghusl. It states that water should not be heated for the dead, indicating a specific funerary practice in Shia fiqh.
